name: artifact-runtime-canvas-target-preserved
description: Preserves a native canvas DOM target required by a first-party script calling getContext().

source_reference.notes: Generic regression coverage for runtime canvas materialization: diagnostics metadata alone is not enough when the carried script expects a real canvas element.

legacy_comparison.reason: Runtime dependency parity is an upstream artifact compiler contract with no legacy comparison.

files.content: const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas'); const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
